race.comment: COSTABIT (8) has been up for a while and due for a change of luck. Sat just off the slow tempo with a plugging fifth over 1600m at Newcastle in this class. Should get the right set-up and go close with the nose roll going on. WHACK ATTACK (3) at his top for this and has the speed to get across from the sticky gate. Much better run when he pushed forward with the 60kg to finish a narrow third over 1600m at this track. Has the ability to overcome the wide gate. YACHIYO (6) blinkers go on third-up after he struck some trouble at the start and dropped out in the straight to finish fifth over 1600m at Kembla Grange. Can take a sit from the gate and close late. SILVER TEMPEST (5) finally found some form at latest when he held a forward position to finish a game second over 1500m at Hawkesbury. Best form is on the good tracks and keep safe.
